finalText:
Done. Twelve files still had the old `db.query(sql, params)` calls — all in `packages/`, each a repo or service module with a get/list/update trio. All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

I left two things alone on purpose:
- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` — vendored code, replaced wholesale on upgrade, not meant to be edited.
- `cache.query(...)` calls — a different method on a different object, not part of this migration.

`node verify.js` confirms the migration is clean.
